## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The failure-report selector should normalize paths when matching so that requested failures with a `./` prefix are selected. This review read both changed files and traced the selectors against the added tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from failure reports, refactors cached selection, and adds selector tests.

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize dot-prefixed failure paths when matching — For `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, `select_failures` returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. Your comparison uses the original path directly, whereas `select_explicit` normalizes it before matching and preserves its original spelling. — Requested failing tests with a `./` prefix are silently omitted from selection. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` against `requested` while returning the original `path`.
